verdict: Developed answers and a convincing point of view reach NCLC 7. A few agreement errors and a narrow vocabulary are what to work on next.

adequation: Introduces themself with details about work and hobbies.
taches.interaction: Answers each question with two or three sentences.
taches.fluidite: About 110 words per minute with few hesitations.
taches.ce_qui_marche: Develops each answer instead of replying with one word.

erreurs.regle: The adjective agrees in gender and number with the noun.
